title: odca-des: Object-Driven Cellular Automata discrete event traffic simulator
description: The ODCA-DES simulator (Object-Driven Cellular Automata on a discrete-event engine) at the version that produced every result in the manuscripts Discrete Event Traffic Simulation Framework using Object-Driven Cellular Automata and Probabilistic Lane Changing Models based on Logistic Functions (Demirtaş, Mirchandani, Zhou).
